newsitem.title: LESOTHO: SOCCER-ZAMBIA BEAT LESOTHO 2-0 IN COSAFA CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZAMBIA BEAT LESOTHO 2-0 IN COSAFA CUP.

text.p: Two early goals from Edward Kangwa and Mwape Miti gave Zambia a 2-0 win over Lesotho in the first round of the new Cosafa Castle Cup on Sunday.
Zambia, the top ranked team in Africa, now join Malawi, Mozambique and Tanzania in the final group round of the new competition for southern African nations.
Lesotho goalkeeper Tseliso Thite handed Zambia both their goals after failing to hold shots. The first rebound was tucked away by Kangwa in the 10th minute and Miti added a second five minutes later.
It was Kangwa's third international goal for Zambia since his debut in December.
Lesotho's second-half onslaught on the visitors' goal was kept at bay by some fine goalkeeping by Zambian Davies Phiri.

Earlier on Sunday, Mozambique enjoyed a crushing 4-0 away win over Swaziland while Botswana were beaten 4-1 at home by Malawi on Saturday. They join Tanzania, who had a bye, in the five-team group competition starting next month.
The other place in the group will be determined on March 16 when Namibia host Zimbabwe in Windhoek.
